about.heading: The Developer
bio: I'm Nileet Savale — Co-Founder & CTO at Stamp'd, and a freshly minted M.S. Computer Science grad from Indiana University (GPA 3.84 / 4.0). I build cloud-native backends, distributed systems, and AI/ML applications that ship to production.

My work spans healthcare data pipelines at IU's Tobias Center, scalable travel-readiness APIs at Stamp'd, and ML research at IU's School of Public Health — all under real reliability, latency, and scalability constraints.
Anime's core theme resonates: relentless growth. Every project is a new arc. Every constraint, a technique to master.

contact.heading: Get in Touch
contact.intro: Open to collaborations, engineering conversations, and interesting problems. Whether it's AI, distributed systems, or something entirely new — I'm listening.
